candidates.name: Ground Turkey Shepherd's Pie
candidates.why: Classic 9x13 bake, weighs and divides cleanly at 14 servings, nothing in the catalog is a mashed-potato-topped turkey bake. Source prints 345 cal / 24g protein at 6 servings on a lean build; our standard build (2.5 lb turkey + real mashed potatoes + cheese) lands ~560 cal / 38g protein. Confidence: est_cal is our build, not the source's.

candidates.name: Turkey Tater Tot Hotdish
candidates.why: Midwest hotdish, the single most batch-friendly casserole shape there is. Source is a macro-tracked recipe: 378 cal / 27.3g protein at 5 servings, so scaling turkey up to a 14-serving pan puts us comfortably over 500 cal with 35g+ protein.

candidates.name: Turkey Tetrazzini
candidates.why: American (not Italian) creamy pasta bake; catalog has bolognese/ragu/marinara/ziti but no mushroom-cream tetrazzini. Source verified at 8 servings, 462 cal / 26g protein; our build raises the turkey and lands ~570 cal / 38g.

candidates.name: Turkey and Stuffing Casserole
candidates.why: Thanksgiving-plate flavor as a weeknight bake; stuffing-mix is on the board and cheap. Source verified at 8 servings, 352 cal / 26g protein; our version doubles the turkey to hit 540 cal / 40g.

candidates.name: Turkey Biscuit Pot Pie Casserole
candidates.why: Biscuit-topped pot pie bakes and portions far better than a pastry pot pie. Source verified but very lean (160 cal / 14g at 8 servings, leftover-turkey quantities); our build uses 3 lb ground turkey plus a full biscuit topping to reach ~555 cal / 36g. Confidence: est_cal is our build, source is much lighter.

candidates.name: Turkey Wild Rice Casserole
candidates.why: Minnesota hotdish classic; no creamy wild-rice dish in the catalog. Board carries rice and brown-rice but not a wild-rice blend, so we would build it on a rice base with a partial wild-rice add. Source verified at 6 servings, 339 cal / 21g; our build ~550 cal / 36g.

candidates.name: Turkey Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes
candidates.why: Meatloaf is genuinely batch-scalable (three loaf pans or one sheet pan) and slices to weight. Catalog has meatballs but no meatloaf. Source verified at 8 servings, 323 cal / 34g protein for the loaf alone; add mashed potatoes and we are at ~590 cal / 40g.

candidates.name: Turkey Sausage Hash Brown Breakfast Bake
candidates.why: Breakfast-for-dinner bake, and the strongest protein-per-dollar candidate in the slice: source verified at 12 servings, 580 cal / 59g protein. Board has ground-turkey and turkey-bacon but no turkey breakfast sausage id, so we would season ground turkey ourselves.

candidates.name: Turkey Cajun Dirty Rice Skillet
candidates.why: Cajun holy-trinity rice skillet; catalog's only dirty rice is a side under pork chops. Source verified (ground turkey + bacon + trinity) but calls for chicken livers, which have no board home and would be dropped. Source prints no nutrition, so est_cal is computed from our standard turkey-and-rice ratios. Confidence: numbers unverified from source.

candidates.name: Red Beans, Turkey Sausage and Rice
candidates.why: Louisiana Monday-night staple, cheapest protein math in the slice (beans + turkey). Source verified at 6 servings, 350 cal / 23g protein; served over a full rice portion at our build it is ~535 cal / 38g.

candidates.name: Turkey Sausage and Potato Hash Skillet
candidates.why: One-pan hash, holds and reheats well. Source verified at 6 servings but light (220 cal / 19g) because it is portioned as a breakfast side; our dinner build doubles the turkey and adds eggs to reach ~520 cal / 35g. Confidence: est_cal is our build.

candidates.name: Turkey Noodle Casserole
candidates.why: The seafood-free answer to tuna noodle casserole, which we can never publish under the no-seafood rule. Source verified at 6 servings, 531 cal / 32g protein, already over the 500-cal bar as written.

candidates.name: Turkey Cordon Bleu Casserole
candidates.why: Two board proteins in one pan (turkey + deli ham) and a Swiss/bechamel angle nothing in the catalog touches. Source verified at 8 servings, 504 cal / 36g protein, already clears the bar.

candidates.name: Cornbread-Topped Turkey Casserole
candidates.why: Savory (not chili) cornbread bake; the catalog's only cornbread dish is a beef chili cornbread casserole, which is a different filling entirely. Source verified at 8 servings, 266 cal / 17g on leftover-turkey quantities; our build triples the turkey to ~540 cal / 36g. Confidence: est_cal is our build.

candidates.name: Turkey Mac and Cheese Bake
candidates.why: Straight cheddar mac with turkey folded in; distinct from the existing High-Protein Turkey Chili Mac, which is a chili base. Source verified at 8 servings but prints no nutrition, so est_cal is computed from our bechamel ratios. Confidence: numbers unverified from source. Flag: dedup should confirm against Turkey Chili Mac.

candidates.name: Scalloped Potato Turkey Casserole
candidates.why: Sliced-potato gratin with turkey; catalog has no scalloped-potato bake at all and potatoes are the cheapest starch on the board. Source verified at 4-6 servings but prints no nutrition. Confidence: numbers unverified from source, est_cal computed from our ratios.

candidates.name: Turkey Florentine Rice Bake
candidates.why: Creamed-spinach turkey bake; distinct from the existing broccoli-cheddar rice skillet. Source verified at 6 servings, 399 cal (protein not printed); over rice at our portion it is ~545 cal with an estimated 34g protein. Confidence: source protein figure unavailable.

candidates.name: Southern Turkey, Tomato and Monterey Jack Bake
candidates.why: Deen Bros skillet bake, corn-chip topped, southern rather than Tex-Mex in seasoning. Source verified as a real recipe but lists no servings and no nutrition. Confidence: all numbers are our estimate; est_cal assumes a rice base added for the 14-serving build.

candidates.name: Cheesy Turkey Sausage and Vegetable Rice Casserole
candidates.why: Stovetop-to-broiler rice casserole, very cheap per serving. Source verified at 6 servings, 304 cal / 20g; our build doubles the turkey to ~515 cal / 34g. Gouda would be swapped for board shredded-cheese. Confidence: est_cal is our build.

candidates.name: Turkey Sausage Gravy Biscuit Bake
candidates.why: Biscuits-and-gravy as a sliceable 9x13; nothing like it in the catalog. Source verified at 8 servings but is built on pork sausage and a packet gravy mix, so our version seasons ground turkey and makes a scratch milk gravy. Confidence: source prints no nutrition and uses a different protein; est_cal is our build.

candidates.name: Sheet-Pan BBQ Turkey Meatballs over Rice
candidates.why: Sheet-pan meatballs scale perfectly to 14 and the BBQ-pineapple flavor is unlike the marinara, Greek, Thai and kofta turkey meatballs already live. Source verified at 4 servings, 549 cal / 28.7g protein as written, already over the bar.

candidates.name: Turkey a la King over Egg Noodles
candidates.why: Retro diner dish, no catalog equivalent (the creamy chicken-and-mushroom entry is a slow-cooker bowl, not a la king). Source verified at 4 servings, 438 cal / 11g protein but it is the chicken version; our turkey build loads the protein to ~540 cal / 35g. Confidence: source is chicken, not turkey; numbers are our build.

candidates.name: Turkey Reuben Casserole
candidates.why: Turkey Reuben (the deli variant) as a bake; sauerkraut, rye-substitute bread and Swiss are all on the board and nothing in the catalog uses sauerkraut. Source verified at 6 servings, 504 cal / 20g protein but built on corned beef; our turkey build raises protein to ~38g. Confidence: source protein is corned beef, not turkey.

candidates.name: Turkey Meatballs and Chickpea Pasta
candidates.why: High-protein-pasta angle (chickpea pasta) that no live recipe uses. Source verified at 5 servings, 404 cal / 31.1g protein. Chickpea pasta has no board id, so pricing would fall back to regular pasta plus a flagged premium. Flag: dedup should check against Turkey Meatball Marinara Pasta, which uses standard pasta and no chickpea angle.

candidates.name: Turkey Pot Pie with Stuffing Topping
candidates.why: Stuffing-crust pot pie, a real regional variant. Source verified at 8 servings, 482 cal / 15g protein; our build triples the turkey to ~530 cal / 36g. Flag: overlaps the biscuit pot pie and the stuffing casserole in this same slice, dedup should keep at most two of the three.

candidates.name: Turkey Sausage and Peppers Rice Skillet
candidates.why: Sausage-and-peppers built on rice rather than pasta; the live Italian Sausage Penne is pork and pasta-based. Source verified at 6 servings but Jennie-O prints no nutrition for it. Confidence: numbers unverified from source, est_cal computed from our ratios.

candidates.name: Turkey Tamale Pie
candidates.why: Cornbread-crust tamale pie; the catalog's cornbread entry is a beef chili bake and the enchilada entry is a skillet, so the shape and filling are both different. Source verified at 8 servings, 523 cal / 27g protein as written, already clears the bar.

candidates.name: Turkey Migas Skillet
candidates.why: Austin breakfast-for-dinner skillet, eggs plus crisped tortilla; no egg-forward Tex-Mex dish in the catalog. Source verified at 4 servings, 261 cal / 10g protein as a meatless migas; our build adds 2.5 lb ground turkey to reach ~510 cal / 36g. Confidence: source contains no turkey, numbers are our build.

candidates.name: Turkey Chile Relleno Casserole Skillet
candidates.why: Deconstructed chile relleno, a cheese-and-egg custard bake with none of the frying that makes the real thing unscalable. Source verified as a real recipe but prints neither servings nor nutrition. Confidence: numbers are our estimate; est_cal assumes a rice base for the 14-serving build.

candidates.name: Ground Turkey Calabacitas Skillet
candidates.why: Calabacitas (zucchini + corn) with turkey; the closest live dish is a beef-and-zucchini rice skillet, which is a cheeseburger-style flavor, not a Mexican one. Source verified at 4 servings, 266 cal / 28g protein without a starch; over rice at our portion it is ~505 cal / 36g. Confidence: est_cal is our build with rice.

candidates.name: Turkey Sopa de Fideo Skillet
candidates.why: Toasted-fideo tomato-chipotle noodle skillet, a Mexican staple with zero catalog presence. Source verified at 6 servings, 383 cal / 36g protein; cooked down to a thick skillet (not soup) at our portion it is ~520 cal / 40g.

candidates.name: Turkey Albondigas in Chipotle Sauce over Rice
candidates.why: Smoky chipotle meatballs over rice; catalog meatballs are marinara, Greek, Thai and kofta, none Mexican. Source verified at 4 servings but Milk Street prints no nutrition. Confidence: numbers unverified from source, est_cal computed from our ratios.

candidates.name: Turkey Meatballs with Arroz Verde
candidates.why: Green-rice (arroz verde) pairing is the distinguishing feature, not the meatball. Source verified at 5 servings, 208 cal for meatballs only, protein not printed; with the rice our portion is ~530 cal / 36g. Flag: pool near-duplicate with the chipotle albondigas above, dedup should keep one unless the green-rice base is judged distinct. Confidence: source protein figure unavailable.

candidates.name: Southwestern Turkey Rice Casserole
candidates.why: Spanish-rice-and-Rotel bake with a crushed-chip crust. Source verified at 6 servings, 710 cal / 31g protein; we would trim the fat and rebuild the Spanish rice from board rice plus seasoning rather than a boxed mix, landing ~600 cal / 38g.

candidates.name: Loaded Ground Turkey Nacho Bake
candidates.why: Sheet-pan nacho bake, portioned by weight rather than plated to order. Source verified at 4-6 servings, ~390 cal / 41g protein; at our portion with a heavier chip base it is ~545 cal / 42g. Note: the live Frito pie casserole is beef and corn-chip-based, this is a tortilla-chip bake.

candidates.name: Turkey Taco Casserole
candidates.why: Layered corn-tortilla-and-refried-bean bake, structurally a lasagna rather than the live Turkey Taco Rice Skillet. Source verified at 6 servings, 599 cal / 43g protein as written, one of the best protein-per-calorie candidates in the slice. Flag: dedup should compare against Turkey Taco Rice Skillet and against the tortilla casserole below.

candidates.name: Mexican Turkey Tortilla Casserole
candidates.why: Fire-roasted tomato and black bean layered bake. Source verified at 6 servings, 464 cal / 35g protein. Flag: pool near-duplicate with Turkey Taco Casserole above (both layered tortilla bakes); dedup should keep one, and the fillings do differ (refried bean vs tomato-bean).

candidates.name: Turkey Taco Pasta Skillet
candidates.why: One-pot taco pasta. Source verified at ~4 servings, 310 cal / 23g protein; our build raises the turkey and cheese to ~520 cal / 35g. Flag: the live Cheesy Taco Spaghetti is the beef version of this dish, so dedup must decide whether the protein swap is enough. Confidence: est_cal is our build.

candidates.name: Crockpot Mexican Turkey Casserole
candidates.why: Slow-cooker dump casserole, the easiest possible 14-serving build. Source verified at 8 servings, 325 cal / 26g protein on a quinoa base; quinoa has no board id so we would build it on rice, landing ~510 cal / 34g. Confidence: est_cal is our rice-based build.

candidates.name: Fiesta Turkey Skillet
candidates.why: Tex-Mex goulash: penne with salsa, sour cream and a heavy vegetable load, which is a different build from a taco-seasoned pasta. Source verified at 6 servings, 310 cal / 21g protein; our build doubles the turkey to ~505 cal / 33g. Flag: pool overlap with the two Mexican pastas in this slice. Confidence: est_cal is our build.

candidates.name: Turkey Huevos Rancheros Rice Bowls
candidates.why: Huevos rancheros rebuilt as a rice bowl so it portions instead of being plated to order. Source verified at 6 servings, 400 cal / 24g protein as an open-faced taco; on rice with extra turkey our portion is ~540 cal / 36g. Queso fresco would be swapped for board feta. Confidence: est_cal is our build.

candidates.name: Turkey Chili Shakshuka Skillet
candidates.why: Chili base with eggs poached into it, which is a different eating experience from a chili bowl. Source verified at 6 servings, 397 cal / 37g protein; our build adds a cornbread or rice side to clear 500. Flag: dedup should confirm it reads as distinct from Slow Cooker Turkey Chili Bowls. Confidence: est_cal is our build.

candidates.name: One-Skillet Turkey and Green Chile Pot Pie
candidates.why: New Mexico green-chile pot pie under drop biscuits, a real regional dish. Source verified at 6 servings, 542 cal / 22g protein; our build raises turkey to ~36g protein at the same calories. Flag: overlaps both the live Green Chile Ground Turkey Skillet and the biscuit pot pie in this slice, dedup should adjudicate.

candidates.name: One-Pot Turkey Mexican Pasta
candidates.why: Salsa-simmered pasta shells, the cheapest Mexican pasta build (no canned tomatoes, no corn). Source verified at 6 servings, 362 cal / 28g protein; our build lands ~505 cal / 35g. Flag: pool near-duplicate with Turkey Taco Pasta Skillet and Fiesta Turkey Skillet; dedup should keep at most two of the three. Confidence: est_cal is our build.

candidates.name: Turkey Spinach Artichoke Wild Rice Casserole
candidates.why: Spinach-artichoke-dip flavor built into a rice casserole; artichoke-hearts are on the board and completely unused by the live catalog. Source verified at 8 servings but prints no nutrition. Confidence: numbers unverified from source, est_cal computed from our ratios. Flag: shares a wild-rice base with the Turkey Wild Rice Casserole above, though the flavor profile is unrelated.
